lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac says the user can override a value a task that only derives that value from a default does not satisfy it the override control is part of the ac
lessons.text: When an AC says the user can override a value, a task that only derives that value from a default does not satisfy it - the override control is part of the AC.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a numeric threshold ac needs boundary tests at limit 1 limit and limit 1 without them and are indistinguishable and the rule is unverified
lessons.text: A numeric threshold AC needs boundary tests at limit-1, limit and limit+1; without them > and >= are indistinguishable and the rule is unverified.

lessons.key: ac_gap::an edge case that only surfaces as a caught exception from a generic call is not detected assert each named condition explicitly
lessons.text: An edge case that only surfaces as a caught exception from a generic call is not detected - assert each named condition explicitly.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a helper written by one task with no task owning its wiring leaves the edge case uncovered every helper needs a named caller in some task
lessons.text: A helper written by one task with no task owning its wiring leaves the edge case uncovered - every helper needs a named caller in some task.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::design docs naming a browser api must be checked against the real surface before tasks chrome tts delivers events via the per utterance onevent callback in ttsoptions not a global event
lessons.text: Design docs naming a browser API must be checked against the real surface before Tasks - chrome.tts delivers events via the per-utterance onEvent callback in TtsOptions, not a global event.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::any await before permissions request or translator create loses the user gesture pass already known values as arguments instead of fetching them in the handler
lessons.text: Any await before permissions.request or Translator.create loses the user gesture - pass already-known values as arguments instead of fetching them in the handler.
